text:
Type: set of two round nesting side tables
Use: holding drinks, books or a lamp beside a sofa or bed; living room, bedroom, reading corner
Style: Scandinavian, traditional, classic
Materials: painted wood, molded rim on the tops
Colors: warm off-white
Shape: two round tops with a raised edge, one tall and one shorter, four splayed legs joined by cross stretchers, smaller one tucks under the larger, light and open
Feel: soft, calm, airy, gentle
Goes with: cream or pastel walls, light wood, linen textiles; Scandinavian, cottage or classic living rooms

product.name: KRAGSTA
product.description: The round shape gives you a generous table top for trays, coffee or tea services. And the neat dimensions make the table easy to place in the room.
